jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The role:

As the Finance Manager, you will oversee the FP&A half of Coram's Finance function, which includes he financial forecast of the business, the analysis that sits around it, and the reporting that tells the leadership team where we actually are against plan. 


Responsibilities:

 - Oversee the company financial model and the forecast: building it, maintaining it, and defending it

 - Regular reporting on actuals versus plan, with early flags when something is drifting

 - The explanation behind the numbers. Why revenue moved, why spend landed where it did, what it means for the next two quarters

 - Cross-functional depth across sales, marketing, R&D and finance. You need to understand what each team is actually doing and how that shows up in the numbers

 - The analysis leadership uses to make decisions: headcount, spend, pricing, planning cycles



Skills and qualifications:

 - 5–10 years of relevant, hands-on experience

 - SaaS operating experience with deep understand of how the model behaves

 - Significant ownership experience:  a model, a forecast, or a P&L line, with a clear story about the impact it had on the business

 - Experience within rapidly scaling organizations. Early stage is a plus 

 - Strong business acumen and very high attention to detail

 - Fluency in your own work with the ability to walk through a complex model you built and talk credibly about forecast accuracy

 - Exposure to fundraising is a plus

 - Exposure to the go-to-market side of the business is a plus

 - Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels

 - Ability to work in an onsite environment



What we offer:

 - Competitive compensation package

 - 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

 - Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

 - 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

 - Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

 - Referral bonuses

 - Free onsite EV charging

 - Daily team dinners and regular team off-sites

 - The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack

We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness. 



Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Independently define and lead strategic GTM work-streams end-to-end, establishing objectives, scope, success metrics, execution plans, and accountability

 - Solve complex GTM challenges by combining data analysis, stakeholder input, and business judgment to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions

 - Partner with senior stakeholders to align on priorities, navigate tradeoffs, secure decisions, and drive execution across teams

 - Experience partnering with senior stakeholders, influencing decisions without formal authority, and building alignment across competing priorities

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with advanced spreadsheet fluency and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations

 - Strong understanding of GTM motions, revenue processes, and the operational challenges of scaling a B2B organization

 - Experience designing and implementing tools, systems, and processes that teams adopt and rely on

 - Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce, including CRM architecture, workflows, data quality, reporting, and best practices

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex issues into clear recommendations for senior audiences

 - Strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to prioritize independently and balance long-term improvements with immediate business needs

 - Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities

 - Current or recent experience at a high-growth, Series A–C company is a plus

 - BA/BS degree required; MBA preferred

 - Able to work onsite

 - Sales programs drive measurable improvements in seller behavior, pipeline creation, and revenue performance

 - Sellers are equipped to effectively leverage Coram’s direct and channel motions

 - Best practices from top performers become repeatable across the field

 - Enablement programs are measured by business impact, not activity alone

jobs.title: HR Director and Business Partner
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The role:

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on HR Director and Business Partner to own and scale our HR operations as Coram continues to grow across the U.S., UK, and India.



This is a broad HR leadership role for someone who has experience across the full employee lifecycle. You’ll inherit many of our existing HR operations and programs, quickly learn what we have in place, and take ownership of refining and scaling them as the company grows.



You’ll oversee areas including payroll, compliance, employee relations, performance management, compensation adjustments, policies, benefits, and broader people operations. You’ll also manage a small, distributed HR team and partner closely with leadership across the organization.




Responsibilities:

 - Own and continuously improve day-to-day HR operations across Coram, building scalable processes without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy

 - Manage, develop, and build a small HR team of approximately 2–3 people, potentially distributed across multiple countries and time zones

 - Learn Coram’s existing HR infrastructure, systems, policies, and programs and identify opportunities to strengthen and scale them

 - Oversee payroll, benefits, employee administration, onboarding, offboarding, and other core HR operations

 - Own and refine performance management, including performance cycles, employee feedback, manager enablement, and performance improvement

 - Partner with leadership on compensation, promotions, leveling, organizational changes, and other employee matters

 - Advise managers on complex employee relations issues and lead internal investigations, ensuring fair, consistent, and well-documented resolutions

 - Own HR compliance across Coram, monitoring federal, state, and local employment requirements and ensuring policies and practices evolve as the company grows

 - Maintain and continuously update employee handbooks, HR policies, and SOPs across the states and countries where Coram operates

 - Oversee key HR compliance audits and reporting, including payroll, I-9s, benefits, workplace safety, EEO-1, OSHA, and ACA requirements

 - Partner closely with Finance, Recruiting, and company leadership on headcount planning and broader people initiatives

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Security & Compliance Lead
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The Role:

We’re hiring our first Lead Security & Compliance Engineer to own security, IT and compliance at Coram. Our customers range from police departments and federal agencies to Fortune 500 companies, schools and hospitals, across the US, UK and Canada. Every one of them asks how we protect their data. You’ll make sure compliance never blocks a deal: you’ll own our certifications, lead customer security reviews, and turn policy into real, automated controls across the company. You’ll work directly with our engineering leadership and start hands-on. As we grow, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the function and the team. 



Responsibilities:

 - Own our compliance programmes end to end, starting with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001: controls, evidence, policies, auditors and remediation.

 - Lead our path to the frameworks customers ask for most, including NDAA / TAA, HIPAA, CJIS, CMMC, ITAR and FedRAMP, and decide which to certify against and which to answer with documentation.

 - Partner with sales on customer security reviews, questionnaires and due-diligence calls, and build a trust centre and reusable answers so deals move faster.

 - Own data flows, retention and privacy controls for sensitive video and biometric data, including GDPR, Illinois BIPA and state-by-state retention rules.

 - Make compliance real: automate onboarding, offboarding and access reviews, and manage identity, SSO, MFA, device management and endpoint protection.

 - Own IT systems and vendors across our US, UK and India offices.

 - Work with engineering on security fixes and architecture changes, and lead incident response and customer communication when something goes wrong.

 - Build a prioritised security roadmap, report progress to leadership, and hire as the function grows.



Qualifications:

 - 8+ years in security, compliance or IT, with ownership of a security and compliance programme at a B2B startup or scale-up.

 - Personally led a SOC 2 Type II audit, plus at least one more framework such as ISO 27001, HIPAA, CJIS, CMMC, ITAR or FedRAMP.

 - Experience selling into enterprise, government, law enforcement, defence or healthcare customers, and working closely with sales on security reviews.

 - Technical enough to work credibly with engineers: scripting (Python or Bash), cloud and infrastructure-as-code basics, identity platforms and device management.

 - Comfortable doing the detailed work yourself, from questionnaires to policies, while keeping the bigger picture in mind.

 - Able to explain risk clearly to non-technical people, and to push back on sales or leadership when it matters.

 - Experience leading or building a team is a plus, but not required.

 - Nice to have: biometric or video privacy experience, physical security or IoT hardware background, and certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or OSCP.
